What Labelbox sells

Builds practice tasks and expert feedback for AI training. Its business software runs AI programs that carry out tasks.

  • Horizon — Training environments where experts grade and evaluate model behavior.
  • WorldSim — Simulates business applications and data for agents training in Horizon.
  • Recursion Managed Agents — AI agents for business tasks, with output scoring to improve specialist models.
  • Terra — Robotics datasets from first-person recordings and remotely controlled demonstrations.
  • Alignerr — Qualified experts create preference data (ratings that show which responses people prefer). They also grade step-by-step task records.
